system.description: Armor Class: 4 Hit Dice: 1* (S) Move: 180' (60') Attacks: 2 bites Damage: 1d6/1d6 No. Appearing: 1d8 (1d4) Save As: Fl Morale: 10 Treasure Type: Nil Intelligence: 2 Alignment: Neutral XP Value: 13 Monster Type: Giant Animal (Rare). Giant shrews look like large, brown-furred rats with long snouts. They can burrow, climb, or jump (up to 5'). The eyes of a giant shrew are so weak that the creature is not affected by light or the lack of it.
